# SAS Pumps (Shaduf Al Sahra Trading)

> UAE supplier (head office in Dubai, serving all seven Emirates) of custom-engineered water pump sets, solar water heaters, agricultural irrigation products, water treatment systems, cooling and heating systems, and air conditioning solutions.

- Areas served: all seven Emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah.
- Sectors served: agriculture, construction (dewatering and site water supply), residential, municipal and government, industrial.
- Process: consultation, then design and fabrication, then installation and ongoing support.
- Contact: +971 58 167 0324, info@saspumps.com, head office Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
